verdicts.evidence: Without the ^ anchor, a line of prose containing `# ` + the word acceptance becomes a section heading. RECIPE: spec with no criteria section at all (`# Spec` / prose `see the # acceptance notes below` / `- login works file:src/auth.ts#login`), project with src/auth.ts exporting login; `node dist/cli.js spec-check s.md -p . --json`. MEASURED shipped: exit 2, verdict no-criteria (misuse). Mutated: exit 0, verdict linked, 1 criterion. A spec the shipped binary refuses as having no section passes green. The dedicated tests miss it: their headings are all in column 0 and their no-section fixture (`just prose, no criteria`) contains no `#`.
